title: Pet Family
story: The guild hall keeps pets. They share a base, but each speaks differently.
goal: Add class Dog and class Cat that inherit from Animal. Dog.speak() returns Woof and Cat.speak() returns Meow. Animal.speak() stays ...
hints: class Dog(Animal): makes Dog a child of Animal. Override the method you want to change.
Do not rewrite __init__: the child inherits it.
socratic: What goes in the brackets after the class name?
Which parts do the children not need to rewrite?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what is the key idea in “Pet Family”?
